added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite (ff112f9f, completed, 3 failures) and after_suite (10082d5a6, completed, 0 failures); added ids = after_ids - base_ids = empty, so the run added no failing test. Two of the base failures are the node's own malformed-value cases failing at base by design (the value echo is the repair); the third, tests/test_schema.py::test_well_formed_evidence_record_with_resolving_shas_is_quiet, is a non-git-scratch-tree artifact and does not affect the subtraction.

findings.text: follow-on: the plan section's second named defect is stale. It states a malformed plan-section-depends-on value 'returns None at _schema.py line 389 with no finding, and every declared wait disappears silently', but at the base revision section_depends_on already returns an entry under SECTION_DEPENDS_ON_DEFECT_KEY carrying the meta and the malformation (reckon/_schema.py:466, :473; verified in the base blob via git show ff112f9f:reckon/_schema.py), and section_dependency_refusals reports it as an invalid-section-dependency finding. No section wait is dropped because the defect entry is a non-identity key the edge builder skips. This is a plan-text correctness issue for the coordinator's writeback, not a defect in the node's change.

follow-on: the manifest's orientation_write_paths (and the same set echoed in the node brief) declares reckon/mcp.py, reckon/mcp_views.py and reckon/lifecycle.py, but the diff touches none of them. A reader reconciling the declared scope against git diff --name-status finds three claimed paths with no delta; harmless here, but the declared set should name the paths the change actually lands in.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation reverts the is_section_scoped guard in lifecycle.unresolved_dependencies and reddens exactly the single-waiting-section summary case (1 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1), so the section-blocking guarantee is guarded rather than assumed; the value echo is pinned by two cases that fail at the base revision, so the message-shaped regression is caught too.
justifications.evidence: the head arm reproduces under my re-run (tests/test_section_edge_summary_and_malformed_mapping.py 4 passed EXIT=0), the negative control demonstrably fires (mutating the guard at reckon/lifecycle.py:47 leaves the summary test as the single failure, negative-control.log), and added_failure_count derives to 0; the base arm's third failure (tests/test_schema.py::test_well_formed_evidence_record_with_resolving_shas_is_quiet) is an artifact of running on a non-git scratch tree and is disclosed, and the manifest flags the base-arm accounting delta 2089/2091 as a follow-on rather than hiding it.
justifications.fit: the echo is bounded at 120 characters and rendered with repr() so a long or quote-bearing declaration cannot ride a transport-bounded response whole or break the message, it sits inside the existing section_depends_on contract without changing the returned shape (still one SECTION_DEPENDS_ON_DEFECT_KEY entry), and the two skills sentences are one contiguous paragraph each at the decision point they govern.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three deliverables land: the single-waiting-section summary reports that section held and the plan unblocked (tests/test_section_edge_summary_and_malformed_mapping.py:91), a malformed mapping yields a named finding (tests/test_section_edge_summary_and_malformed_mapping.py:120), and both skills carry the gate-vs-section-edge sentence (skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md:233, skills/reckon-create/SKILL.md:326); the node's discovery that the two named defects were already repaired at base is correct and independently confirmed (reckon/lifecycle.py:47 guard, introduced by 719406d01 before base), so the only new repair is the value echo, pinned by two base-failing cases.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status ff112f9f..b6c99bcfe lists only reckon/_schema.py, tests/test_section_edge_summary_and_malformed_mapping.py, skills/reckon-create/SKILL.md, skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared set, with reckon/mcp.py, reckon/mcp_views.py and reckon/lifecycle.py correctly left untouched; no shared index, sprint or plan state is modified.
